name: Inkling-2-Mini UD-Q4_K_M (Thinking Machines, looped MoE 26B, 8 of 128 experts, vision; A4500 only)
notes: New architecture (inkling2_loop): 24 layers, the middle 12 run three times (48 layer passes per token), MoE 8 of 128 experts, hybrid local (1024 window) + global attention, vision. Needs llama.cpp newer than the main kernel: kernel bin-inkling = upstream 91979450 + PR #32695 (Daniel Han, looped Inkling-2-Mini, not merged yet; no V100 MMVQ patch, it does not apply). Runs on the A4500 alone: split over both cards (UD-Q8_K_XL, any -ts) it made only ~5 tok/s (12.7k graph nodes and ~400 GPU-to-GPU splits per token: each looped layer's weights sit on the card of its first pass, the later passes run wherever -ts puts them; -sm row and -sm tensor are not supported for it), the Q4_K_M on one A4500 makes ~35. The GGUF counts 48 layers (looped) for 24 layers of weights. The chat template ignores enable_thinking; reasoning is set with reasoning_effort (none/minimal/low/medium/high, default 0.9 = high). Configs ending in -min set the server default to minimal (closest to thinking off); requests can still override it. Sampling: temperature 1.0 (generation_config). ts = A4500,V100. Its compute buffer grows with context x ubatch (about 3.3 GB at 32k x 512), so the A4500 takes 32k at ub 256, 64k at ub 128 (q8 KV), 128k at ub 64 (q4 KV, vision projector on the CPU). DSpark: unsloth's drafter does not load in this build (markov_w1 expects the unpadded 200058 vocabulary, the file has 201024; DSpark for Inkling is PR #32218, not merged).
